This question requires synthesis from multiple source documents. The retrieved context below is grouped by document — all documents shown are relevant to the question.

Response type rules:
- Use response_type "answer" if the combined context across all documents supports the answer, even if no single document contains the complete answer.
- Use response_type "partial_answer" only if required documents are genuinely missing from the context — not because evidence is split across documents.
- Use response_type "not_found" only if none of the provided documents contain the needed information.
- Use response_type "refuse_no_access" if the user lacks permission to access required documents.
- Use response_type "clarify" if the question is ambiguous about approval stage, location, data type, or role.
- Do not downgrade to "partial_answer" solely because evidence comes from two or more separate documents.

Citation rules:
- Cite at least one chunk per document that contributed facts to your answer.
- Do not omit a document because its contribution is supplementary — if it added a fact, cite it.
- Every citation must include document_id, document_title, section_heading, chunk_id, and citation_text.
- citation_text must be a short exact or near-exact excerpt from the cited chunk.
- Do not cite a chunk unless it directly supports a specific claim in the answer.

Safety rules:
- Answer only from the retrieved context.
- If the user lacks access, use response_type "refuse_no_access" and do not reveal restricted content.
- If conversation memory is provided, use it only to clarify the current question. Do not treat memory as source evidence.
- Do not invent policy details, numbers, dates, prices, legal advice, customer commitments, or unstated exceptions.

Question:
I manage someone starting at Northstar. What buddy/check-in tasks are mine, and who initiates and fulfills the standard new-hire equipment request?

Retrieved context (grouped by document):
=== Document: HR-001 — Employee Handbook ===

[Section: Onboarding Basics]
Chunk ID: 3c0ff18d-c2c6-4655-b39f-b0594d3ea77d
Score: 0.5709
Content:
Onboarding Basics

New employees complete onboarding during their first 10 business days. Required onboarding includes security training, benefits enrollment, department orientation, and access review. Managers are responsible for assigning a buddy and scheduling the first 30-day check-in.

Employees should complete mandatory security awareness training before accessing customer data or production systems.

[Section: Company Overview]
Chunk ID: 9cc339b6-8f98-422e-b2bf-e01f705ea379
Score: 0.5434
Content:
Company Overview

Northstar Analytics builds analytics and workflow automation software for operations teams in finance, healthcare operations, logistics, and professional services. Employees are expected to protect customer trust, communicate clearly, and make decisions that improve operational reliability.

Northstar has offices in Toronto, Montreal, and New York. The company supports hybrid work and approved remote work across Canada and the United States.

=== Document: OPS-001 — Vendor, Travel, and Equipment Operations Policy ===

[Section: Equipment Requests]
Chunk ID: efa74b64-3c3e-4f86-bec3-63476871ca6b
Score: 0.6164
Content:
Equipment Requests

Standard equipment includes a laptop, charger, headset, keyboard, mouse, and monitor. New-hire equipment is initiated by HR Admin and fulfilled by IT Admin. Replacement equipment requires the employee to state whether the request is due to breakage, loss, upgrade, or accessibility need.

Equipment above the standard bundle requires manager approval. Lost equipment that may contain company data must be reported to IT Admin immediately and should not wait for the next business day.

=== Document: LEGAL-001 — Contract, NDA, and Data Retention Policy ===

[Section: Contract Approval Process]
Chunk ID: 56f368ca-8cf8-4eec-b828-67bb1302a583
Score: 0.5810
Content:
Contract Approval Process

| Contract Type | Legal Review | Finance Review | Final Approver |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard customer order form under USD 25,000 ARR | Optional unless redlines exist | Deal Desk | Sales Manager |
| Customer contract with security addendum | Required | Deal Desk | Sales Director |
| Vendor agreement under USD 10,000 | Required if data processing applies | Finance | Department Manager |
| Vendor agreement USD 10,000 or above | Required | Finance | Department Leader |
| Employment-related agreement | Required | HR Admin | People Leader |

No employee may sign a contract on behalf of Northstar unless they are listed in the signature authority register maintained by Legal Operations.

[Section: NDA Rules]
Chunk ID: 62cce0e9-c921-4e57-afe8-2d518cf60c29
Score: 0.5373
Content:
NDA Rules

Northstar's standard mutual NDA may be sent to prospects, vendors, and partners by Sales Representatives or Managers after confirming the recipient's legal entity name. Non-standard NDAs, unilateral NDAs, and NDAs with unusual confidentiality periods require Legal review before signature.

Employees must not promise that Northstar will accept a customer's NDA without review. The approved talk track is: "We can review your NDA or provide our standard mutual NDA through Legal Operations."

=== Document: IT-001 — Acceptable Use Policy ===

[Section: Approved Use]
Chunk ID: 27583c5a-ba2e-4d83-b7b6-a933c0360595
Score: 0.5575
Content:
Approved Use

Northstar systems must be used for company business, approved learning, customer support, and authorized operational work. Employees may use company devices for limited personal use if it does not interfere with work, create security risk, or violate policy.

=== Document: SALES-001 — Sales Playbook ===

[Section: Approved Talk Track]
Chunk ID: 4f057818-24db-49a8-be3b-73811b3d858c
Score: 0.5262
Content:
Approved Talk Track

Northstar helps operations leaders see where work slows down, which approvals are delayed, and which data quality issues affect business reporting. Sales Representatives should avoid promising product roadmap commitments.

=== Document: SALES-002 — Product Positioning and FAQ ===

[Section: Integrations]
Chunk ID: 8d4e31c2-d911-433c-892c-fb68cb73f2db
Score: 0.4975
Content:
Integrations

Northstar supports common data warehouse, ticketing, and workflow integrations through approved connectors and APIs. Sales Representatives should confirm exact integration support with Solutions Engineering.

=== Document: SALES-003 — Competitive Battlecard ===

[Section: Positioning Against Workflow Tools]
Chunk ID: e4ccd836-49df-48c8-b260-8e8a706a4228
Score: 0.4970
Content:
Positioning Against Workflow Tools

When compared with workflow-only tools, position Northstar as analytics plus process visibility. Workflow tools coordinate tasks, while Northstar tracks patterns, bottlenecks, and KPI impact across workflows.

=== Document: HR-004 — Benefits Overview ===

[Section: Health Benefits]
Chunk ID: 64f32d21-dc10-42cc-b275-395f3ef6f1e6
Score: 0.4970
Content:
Health Benefits

Northstar provides health, dental, and vision benefits to eligible full-time employees. Coverage begins on the first day of the month after the employee's start date. Plan details vary by employee location.

This overview does not include provider contracts, claim adjudication rules, or legal advice about benefits eligibility.
